Directory Visibility

You control how other participants discover you.

The directory supports cross-border networking while keeping your preferences and security as priority.

Information that may be shared

Business name, country, expertise, business interests, and selected collaboration goals may be visible with participant consent.

Information kept private

Personal contact details, payment information, passwords, documents, and sensitive identifiers are never shown in the public directory.

Directory participation is optional. You can adjust visibility settings or hide your profile through privacy controls.

Professional use

Directory data may only be used for respectful business networking and verified event collaboration activities.
